macros.name: Frame
macros.doc: The macro \Frame can be used to typeset ads or other text into larger boxes inside the frame of the crossword puzzle.

macros.name: KakuroHintType
macros.doc: This macro contains the cell type used when typesetting a Kakuro hint.

macros.name: KakuroNumberFont
macros.doc: This macro contains the definition of the font switching macros used when typesetting a Kakuro hint.

macros.name: PuzzleBlackBox
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleBlackBox contains the commands to produce the black boxes.

macros.name: PuzzleClueFont
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleClueFont contains the font changing command issued before the clues are typeset.

macros.name: PuzzleCluePost
macros.doc: This macro contains the code to be inserted after the clues are typeset in normal mode.

macros.name: PuzzleCluePre
macros.doc: This macro contains the code to be inserted before the clues are typeset in normal mode.

macros.name: PuzzleContent
macros.doc: This macro contains the content of a cell during formatting this cell.

macros.name: PuzzleDefineCell
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleDefineCell is a user command to define a new cell type.

macros.name: PuzzleFont
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleFont contains the font changing command issued before the frame of the crossword puzzle.

macros.name: PuzzleHook
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleHook is called at the end of the Puzzle environment. It can be used to place additional graphical elements in the puzzle frame.

macros.name: PuzzleLetters
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleLetters can be used to typeset the list of used letters in numbered crossword puzzles.

macros.name: PuzzleLettersText
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleLettersText contains the text which is typeset at the beginning of the macro \PuzzleLetters.

macros.name: PuzzleLineThickness
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleLineThickness contains the width of the line used to frame the cells.

macros.name: PuzzleNumberFont
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleNumberFont contains the font changing command issued before a number in the frame of the crossword puzzle is typeset.

macros.name: PuzzleNumbers
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleNumbers can be used to generate a numbered list of boxes for the numbered crossword puzzles.

macros.name: PuzzlePost
macros.doc: This macro contains the code to be inserted after a puzzle is typeset.

macros.name: PuzzlePre
macros.doc: This macro contains the code to be inserted before a puzzle is typeset.

macros.name: PuzzlePutNumber
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzlePutNumber is a configuration macro which typesets the number in a cell.

macros.name: PuzzleSolution
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleSolution arranges everything such that the following puzzles are typeset in the “solution” mode, i.e. the letters are shown and the clues are suppressed.

macros.name: PuzzleSolution
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleSolution arranges everything such that the following puzzles are typeset in the “solution” mode, i.e. the letters are shown and the clues are suppressed.

macros.name: PuzzleSolutionContent
macros.doc: This macro processes the letter in solution mode.

macros.name: PuzzleUnitlength
macros.doc: The length \PuzzleUnitlength determines the width and height of each single box in the frame of a crossword puzzle.

macros.name: PuzzleUnsolved
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleUnsolved arranges everything such that the following puzzles are typeset in the “unsolved” mode, i.e. the letters are suppressed and the clues are shown.

macros.name: PuzzleWordsText
macros.doc: The macro \PuzzleWordsText contains the text which is typeset at the beginning of the environment PuzzleWords.

macros.name: SudokuLinethickness
macros.doc: This macro contains the thickness of the thick lines in a sudoku.

macros.name: Word
macros.doc: The macro \Word is defined inside the environment PuzzleWords. It takes one argument which is the word itself.

envs.name: Puzzle
envs.doc: This package provides the environment Puzzle which typesets the frame of a crossword puzzle.

envs.name: PuzzleClues
envs.doc: The clues in the classical crossword puzzle are typeset with the use of the environment PuzzleClues.

envs.name: PuzzleWords
envs.doc: The environment PuzzleWords can be used to typeset the list of words for a fill-in puzzle.

envs.name: Sudoku
envs.doc: The input for a Sudoku is given in a specialized environment.
